slides.texte_overlay:
small things people judge
you on within seconds

how you hold yourself

before you speak, people read your posture. shoulders relaxed and back, chin level, tell everyone you're comfortable, and that calm confidence spreads around the room.

your handshake or wave

a warm, steady greeting tells people you're glad to see them. a rushed or limp one can make even a kind person seem nervous, distracted or a little uninterested.

your smile

a real smile reaches your eyes, not just your mouth. people notice the difference within a second, and a genuine smile makes them instantly relax and trust you more.

how curious you seem

curiosity shows on your face before you say a word, and it grows when you feed your mind daily. a curious face looks open, warm and easy to approach at once.

slides.texte_overlay:
how you listen

people notice within seconds whether you're really listening or just waiting to talk. nodding, eye contact and a follow up question make them feel heard straight away.
